resources.string: Plan the heist, steal the loot and launch the getaway.
Blue: start zone • Gold edge: target face

1. Connect Bluetooth, then tap an empty square to add an obstacle.

2. Drag an obstacle to move it. Drag outside the grid to remove it.

3. Hold an obstacle to choose its target face. The gold edge shows the selected face.

4. Tap Start when the arena is set up. Manual drive and Stop send commands to the robot.

Blue cells mark the start zone. Obstacle numbers stay white; recognized target IDs appear larger. The robot arrow and N/E/S/W label show its heading.
Returning home clears this arena layout. The Bluetooth connection stays open.
Clears the obstacles and returns the on-screen robot to its start position. This does not send a stop command.
20 by 20 arena. Tap to place obstacles, hold to choose a target face, drag to move, or drag outside the grid to remove.
